cards.note: Already an npm bundle package (dsh.bundle.patch + cordis.patch.yml insert row); no repository-plugin artifacts, dsh.plugin.json or repository rows exist to convert.
Client half already declares the merged dsh.client field (platform web + ./client export); no legacy dshClient field or dsh.plugin.json is present.
dsh.client is declared with platform web and the ./client export the alpha.2 client-modules scan requires; no dshClient-era manifest remains.
The only undeclared-service read is the optional third-party betterLocale store, probed weakly via ctx.get and undefined-guarded; every injected service used (slots, locale) is declared in inject.
Optional service read through weak ctx.get('betterLocale') with a graceful no-op when absent; no property access (ctx.betterLocale) anywhere.
Neither half subscribes to session/event or derives session state from event fields; the seat reads the Chat snapshot through useChat.
Client inject is slots+locale only; no ctx.sessions or removed client-runtime session API is consumed, so no Node-half aggregation route is needed.
The host half registers nothing and never tails task/job output; no tasks.peek reference exists.
No httpServer/tasks/onTaskDone identifiers: the host half injects nothing and the browser half injects slots+locale only.
No ImageAttachmentRef, read_image output or persisted image metadata is touched; the kept card derivations read/terminal carry no image fields.
read_image is neither registered, wrapped, parsed nor snapshot-tested; it is not one of the specimen derivations migrated here.
No custom DeepSeek LLM adapter, image request interceptor or attachment upload cache exists in either half.
No ctx.remote or old APIProxy call site; the seat consumes only the slot owner props and the useChat standard hook.
No third-party persisted SessionEvents are produced; the final target is alpha.2, where A2-01 restores the marker anyway.

The old seat recomputed ui-conversation's internal conversationContextKey against the flat session chat slice; it now scans the public ChatSnapshot order + keyed node store for the tool-call node owning its call id.
No launcher wrapper, Python SDK/ACP integration or direct profile-file reader; the bundle patch is a plain insert row.
No headless wrapper or stdout/stderr parser in the plugin.
No tool presentation mode, PTC preset, dispatch waterfall or related type is used.
No permission/approval/WebFetch policy or audit registration; the row carries only merge config.
No custom loopback HTTP/WS/RPC route, browser page or /api handler; the plugin contributes a slot registration only.
Not a model provider plugin; the optional settings-page sign-in capability has no call site here.

Localization uses the public ctx.locale.register plus a third-party betterLocale override store (a different entry point from locale.addLanguage); no custom i18n patch or shim is carried, so the optional capability is not required.
No subagent orchestration or selector code.
Informational deployment behavior of the official DeepSeek adapter; plugin code needs no change and this repo configures no adapter.
No PowerShell/Bash or Windows directory-picker compatibility workarounds exist to retire.
session-log-deepseek is not mounted or configured; no session-log egress is introduced.
The plugin ships no browser acceptance script or wrapper (no test harness in the tree), so no hardcoded web URL/bundle path/startup log format exists to migrate.
No userQuestions.registerProvider or structured-question answerer registration.
No agent-preset inference from persisted sessions and no agent-presets roots configuration.
No isTokenDelta import or TPS/first-token computation in the row.
The plugin is a delta bundle patch (insert-only row), not a profile/base-composition maintainer; no telemetry or package-inventory rows are restated.
No @earendil-works/pi-ai dependency or provider/auth plugin code.

dsh-client-runtime removed from dsh.client.inject and peers; client context type re-homed to @deepseek-ai/cordis and the chat vocabulary to dsh-client-ui-chat/client, with ui-conversation kept only as a type owner.

Assembly row name equals the bare package name and the package declares dsh.client plus ./client and ./package.json exports, so the bundle id, row id and manifest lookup all key on @bench/dsh-bench-merge-calls.
The seat reads tool-call Chat nodes, not session timelines or user-message content, so the durable event window is not its gap; the Chat target supplies the read.
No composer DOM manipulation, draft injection, history recall or selection handling.

No MarkdownText/fenced CodeBlock render exists in this tree: the web/diff derivations are among the four elided specimens. If they are restored, the alpha.2 nested labels (markdown.code/footnotes) are the required shape.
No ctx.connection.api consumption; the seat receives the chat read through the useChat standard hook instead of history/transcript RPCs.
No subagent seed/persisted descriptor construction or subagent/descriptor assertions.
No ctx.workspaces or ctx.uiWorkspace navigation/directory calls; the only services injected are slots and locale.
No third-party persisted SessionEvent producer or persistence/reload transport layer in the plugin.
No ctx.remote unary/stream calls, so neither RemoteResult nor RemoteError handling exists to migrate.

Client peers re-pinned from 0.1.0-rc.6 to 0.1.2-alpha.2 on their owning packages, and the framework peers re-scoped to @deepseek-ai/cordis / @deepseek-ai/schemastery per docs/rescope.md; no package manager or lockfile is used by this repo.
No startup wrapper or CI matrix with Node-24 workarounds exists in the plugin tree (engines are not constrained here).
The plugin does not consume pluginInventory/list or validate PluginInventorySnapshot.
No host.describe or ctx.remote.$host read; the POSIX home used for path display arrives through the toolview owner props (home), not the Remote face.
The plugin mounts none of dsh-tool-todo/dsh-tool-subagent/dsh-agent/dsh-agent-loop/dsh-terminal-bash and peers on none of them, so the sessionProjections peer/inject change does not reach it.
No ctx.settings.register/update/get or settingsNamespace import on either half.
